reference: J.C. Lin, K.C. Hsieh, R.C. Sharma, and Y.A. Chang, Bull. Alloy Phase Diagrams, 10(4), 340-347 (1989) doi:10.1007/bf02877589; compiled in H. Okamoto, Desk Handbook: Phase Diagrams for Binary Alloys, 2nd ed., ASM International, Materials Park, OH (2010), p. 723
comment: evidence_class=assessed_phase_diagram (expert-drawn diagram, not experimental, not CALPHAD); ORCHID assessed-phase-assemblages v1.0.0, diagram PB-TE-p723; one point per phase field (centroid or pole of inaccessibility); single-phase: the phase at the point composition; two-phase: phases present, compositions unknown (null) with __HYPERPLANE__ at the point's overall composition.
